assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Phase A character concept sheet, review concept rather than rig-ready separated parts. Hand-painted 2D game art, original storybook cartoon design for Ironoak, Gaul circa 50 BC. Soft painterly brush textures and smooth shapes, bold chunky silhouettes, exaggerated large heads and hands and small feet, warm saturated palette, gentle warm rim light from top-left, Celtic knotwork details, thin dark-warm outlines on characters. No pixel art, no photorealism, no 3D render, no franchise designs, no watermark. Brenna, an agile determined young Celtic woman slinger, vivid red hair in one long thick braid, green woven wool tunic with restrained gold Celtic trim, brown leather belt and gold buckle, brown checked trousers, small leather boots, practical leather sling and stone pouch. Friendly expressive face, approximately three heads tall, consistent outfit and facial features in every view. Landscape 1920x1080 composition on a clean warm ivory studio background. Carefully organised model sheet: top row has equally sized full-body FRONT, RIGHT SIDE PROFILE and BACK turnaround with feet on same baseline; bottom row has three isolated face studies (determined, delighted, worried) and one full-body action pose aiming and releasing a handheld leather sling to the right, no bow. Every figure fully visible with generous separation. Pose and construction clear for a later human animator. Keep braid attachment, tunic hem, belt and pouch consistent in all views. Text: no text or labels. No extra props.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Phase A STYLE FRAME 01, Oak Road forest, high-resolution side-view 2D platformer art-direction illustration. Output 1920x1080 pixels, widescreen 16:9. Reference image 1 is ONLY our own Brenna design and brush/material language, preserve that character identity. Hand-painted 2D game art, original storybook cartoon design for Ironoak, Gaul circa 50 BC. Soft painterly brush textures and smooth shapes, bold chunky silhouettes, exaggerated large heads and hands and small feet, warm saturated palette, gentle warm rim light from top-left, Celtic knotwork details, thin dark-warm outlines on characters. No pixel art, no photorealism, no 3D render, no franchise designs, no watermark. A sunny Celtic oak forest in greens and golds with dappled top-left sunlight and subtle canopy rays, living carved oak, bronze spiral accents, drifting pollen. Strict side-on playable composition, no isometric camera: an organic earth platform with bright grassy lip clearly crosses the lower quarter of the frame. Brenna stands on the path facing right, full body approximately 12 percent of frame height, clearly readable against calm background. One bright glowing amber sap knot in a gnarled oak at reachable height, unmistakable spiral silhouette. Visually establish six depth bands: dark soft foreground leaves at the outer corners only; bright playable path and interactable tree; middle-distance muted shrubs; separate cool desaturated woodland silhouettes; still lighter blue distant hills; pale sky. The three background bands must read distinctly. Environments have no dark outlines. Gameplay path and sap knot have highest contrast; background low contrast and cool, hero gets warm rim light. Restrained fine brush grain, smooth painted forms, no grids or tile seams. No UI, text, labels, logos, watermark. This is one composed look-development painting, not a production sprite layer export.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is our own Oak Road style-frame edit target. Keep its painterly materials, forest design, terrain, light direction, colors, composition and all environmental silhouettes unchanged. Change ONLY these two scale/readability issues: reduce Brenna to 12 percent of the total canvas height (about 130 pixels in a 1080-pixel-tall composition), standing on the SAME path baseline near the left quarter, preserving her face, braid, outfit and full-body right-facing pose. She should be a small gameplay-scale hero, not a large portrait. Remove the previous oversized character cleanly and paint the forest behind her seamlessly. Move the amber glowing spiral sap knot down the main oak trunk so its center is about one small Brenna height above the path, making it reachable; keep it bright but reduce its diameter to half a small Brenna height. Everything else unchanged. Maintain widescreen 16:9, target 1920x1080, no text or UI.
